candidates.original_title: Reading Literary Fiction Improves Theory of Mind
candidates.description: Reading literary fiction compared to popular genre fiction improves Theory of Mind performance on the Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test (RMET), as tested in Experiment 5 of Kidd and Castano (2013).
candidates.citation_sentence: These experiments are preregistered replications and extensions of the fifth experiment reported in Kidd and Castano (2013).
candidates.notes: Experiment 3 RMET main effect was significant (p = .027); the 95% CI of the effect size [.026, .449] is entirely above d33% (.203) and does not include zero, making it a successful replication per the small telescopes analysis.
